title: NeuronSpark: Selective Spiking State Space Models with Adaptive Computation for Language Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2603.16148v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Spiking neural networks promise brain-inspired neural dynamics, yet native large-scale spiking language-model pretraining remains largely unexplored relative to conversion, distillation, and backbone-adaptation approaches. We diagnose a central obstacle: standard spiking neurons apply the same firing sensitivity to every token, creating dense- or silent-firing regimes that are difficult to resolve with globally tuned parameters alone. This problem is particularly acute in language modeling, where a single sequence contains tokens of vastly different informational roles, making a uniform firing regime poorly matched to the data. We address this with NeuronSpark, a self-attention-free language model built around input-dependent spiking membrane dynamics, where each neuron's decay rate, gain, and firing threshold adapt to the current token content. translated_title: NeuronSpark：面向语言建模的具有自适应计算的选择性脉冲状态空间模型
translated_abstract: 脉冲神经网络有望实现类脑的神经动力学，然而与转换、蒸馏和主干适配等方法相比，原生的大规模脉冲语言模型预训练在很大程度上仍未被探索。我们诊断出一个核心障碍：标准的脉冲神经元对每个词元施加相同的发放敏感性，从而产生密集发放或静默发放的状态，仅靠全局调参难以解决这一问题。这个问题在语言建模中尤为突出，因为单个序列中包含信息角色差异极大的词元，使得统一的发放机制与数据特性不匹配。我们提出 NeuronSpark 来解决这一问题，这是一个无需自注意力的语言模型，其核心是基于输入依赖的脉冲膜动力学，其中每个神经元的衰减率、增益和发放阈值都会根据当前词元内容进行自适应调整。结合门控联想记忆与自适应时间聚合机制，这种选择性设计……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出 NeuronSpark，一个无需自注意力的选择性脉冲状态空间语言模型，通过让每个神经元的衰减率、增益和发放阈值随输入词元内容自适应调整，解决了标准脉冲神经元统一发放敏感性所导致的密集或静默发放问题。
en_tdlr: NeuronSpark is a self-attention-free selective spiking state space language model in which each neuron's decay rate, gain, and firing threshold adapt to the current token, overcoming the uniform firing sensitivity of standard spiking neurons that causes dense- or silent-firing regimes in language modeling.
